_meta.description: Supplement-to-biomarker interaction map. Used in Vector 3 analysis for mechanistic rationale and antagonistic interaction flags.

NAC.effect: Glutathione precursor - replenishes hepatic antioxidant capacity
NAC.indication: ALT or AST >2x optimal, hepatotoxic compound use

TUDCA.effect: Bile acid chaperone - reduces ER stress and hepatocyte apoptosis
TUDCA.indication: Hepatotoxic compound stack, persistent ALT elevation

Citrus_Bergamot.effect: HMG-CoA reductase inhibition, TG reduction, HDL improvement
Citrus_Bergamot.caution: Mild anticoagulant - monitor with blood thinners

CoQ10_Ubiquinol.effect: Mitochondrial electron chain cofactor, counters statin CoQ10 depletion

Omega3_FA_EPA_DHA.effect: TG reduction, anti-inflammatory, platelet aggregation reduction

Berberine.effect: AMPK activator - improves insulin sensitivity, reduces TG and glucose
Berberine.caution: CYP3A4 inhibitor. Potentiates metformin. Avoid if on cyclosporine.

Zinc.indication: Zinc <70 ug/dL, low testosterone, elevated E2
Zinc.timing: Away from meals or with small meal
Zinc.caution: High dose (>50mg sustained) depletes Copper. Supplement 2mg Copper with >50mg Zinc.

Vitamin_D3_K2.effect: Testosterone synthesis support, immune modulation, calcium metabolism
Vitamin_D3_K2.dose: 2000-5000 IU D3 daily + 100-200 mcg K2 MK-7

Ashwagandha_KSM66.effect: Cortisol reduction, testosterone support, HPA axis modulation
Ashwagandha_KSM66.indication: Cortisol >20, overtraining signs, low testosterone with high stress

DHEA.effect: Adrenal androgen precursor, downstream testosterone/estrogen conversion
DHEA.caution: Physician oversight required. Can elevate estradiol via aromatization.

Magnesium_Glycinate.effect: 700+ enzymatic reactions, sleep quality, insulin sensitivity, blood pressure
Magnesium_Glycinate.indication: RBC Mg <4.8, poor sleep, muscle cramps, high training volume
Magnesium_Glycinate.note: Glycinate or malate forms preferred for bioavailability and GI tolerance

Iron_Bisglycinate.effect: Heme synthesis, oxygen transport, energy metabolism
Iron_Bisglycinate.dose: 25-50 mg elemental iron on empty stomach
Iron_Bisglycinate.caution: Take with Vitamin C to enhance absorption. Separate from calcium/antacids by 2 hours.

antagonistic_interactions.Zinc_vs_Copper: High-dose Zinc (>50mg) depletes Copper. Monitor with serum Copper.
antagonistic_interactions.Iron_vs_Zinc: Concurrent high-dose Iron and Zinc compete for absorption. Separate by 4 hours.
antagonistic_interactions.Berberine_vs_CYP3A4: Berberine inhibits CYP3A4. Monitor medications metabolized via this pathway.
antagonistic_interactions.NAC_vs_Antibiotics: NAC may reduce antibiotic efficacy. Separate by 2 hours.
antagonistic_interactions.Omega3_vs_Anticoagulants: Omega-3 at >4g/day has anticoagulant effects. Monitor with blood thinners.
antagonistic_interactions.DHEA_vs_Aromatization: DHEA can elevate estradiol significantly. Monitor E2 closely.
